title: 第7章 清算
slug: 次元论坛全本免费-次元论坛最新章节列表
content_zh:
【楼主真窝囊，不能因为是你亲戚，就这么纵容她们！】
【谁让都是我老婆呢？男人嘛！宽容一些吧……】
【……已拉黑！】
（咳咳，不知道“八连杀食神”典故的，欢迎去看东东前一部小说“食戟之冒牌小当家”。）
比黑名单还黑的，还有贡连家主现在的脸色。
杜兰城的几名议员，古怪的在脸色变成了黑锅底的贡连家主脸上扫了扫……
其他家族的家主，还能自我控制一下，而钟离家主则是已经在哼哼了。
听了关立远的话，他们也大概能明白是怎么回事儿！
虽然以贡氏家族在杜兰城的地位，不可能因为关立远一句话，就真的伤筋动骨，即便他是开灵双职业也不行！
当然，如果是“空间掌控者”、“灵魂行者”之类的双职业，或许真的会令联盟震惊，把贡氏家族连根拔起也不是不可能。
即便是现在，贡连明白不会有什么实质的损伤，但是……丢人啊！
此时贡连心里，已经将田贡好骂得狗血喷头。
贡氏家族不止有一个管家，准确的说田贡好只是因为是他小妾的一个亲戚，才破例挂名个“管家”的！
如果一些正常的话，关立远也会成为田贡好的私奴，只是借用了贡氏家族的名声。
占这种对贡氏家族来说的“小便宜”也就罢了，居然还手尾不利索！
而另一个被贡连记恨到了深处的对象，自然就是拒绝了他的“好意”的关立远……
区区一个走了狗屎运的小子，居然敢和贡氏家族对抗？谁给他的勇气！
而钟离犼这时则是落井下石的说道：“呸！真他‘哔’的丢杜兰城人的脸……哦，贡连家主，我没说你，我刚才在想其他事情。嗯，六年级一年的学费，加上‘好处费’，你想要多少钱？回头我让人送到你府上。”
巴议员这时也开口道：“怎么回事儿？只上了四个月的学？”
如果关立远“开灵”没有成功，联盟议员绝对不会出这个头，但是现在情况自然不同，连宋院长也面色有些难看，狠狠瞪了一眼向自己投来求助目光的辛主任。

贡连家主这时缓缓开口道：“嗯，我回去会看看负责这件事的是谁，下午就把人送到联盟！”此时他已经决定放弃田贡好。
而宋院长见贡氏的家主都弃车保帅，他就更不敢抗事儿了！
“辛博！你给我站出来！你是负责学籍档案的主任，今天你解释不清楚的话，就自己去联盟的审判所走一趟吧！”
“院、院长……我……”辛主任已经知道自己的下场了，他怎么也不会想到，四个月前自己“随手”做出的一套假档案，居然会牵连出觉醒双职业的天才！
同时他也明白，这意味着自己完了……
不但主任生涯到此结束，恐怕进了审判所，再出来就不知道要多久之后……还要祝愿关立远之后不会有什么突出的表现，不然他恐怕没机会出来了。
“宋院长！这不仅仅是管理档案的人的问题！你之后也给我自查，今年的任期到后，你也没必要继续做这个院长了！”巴议员说道。
人和人还是区别的，贡氏家族可以弃车保帅，但是宋院长……显然不能保全自己院长的位置。
而这时关立远注意到，巴议员歉意的看了自己一眼，似乎是在示意，他只能做到这个程度了……
关立远也理解联盟的窘境，对巴议员勉强扯出了些笑意。
虽然理解，但是关立远心中依旧无法接受，否则也不会直接提出，让钟离秋帮自己还钱……
宋院长哭丧着一张脸，但是想到自己任期本来就不久了，总算只是提前退休，这才强打精神，继续完成着结业讲话。
当然，现在学员们的气氛，有些诡异就是了，尤其是在看向已经站在前排的关立远的时候……
本来按照规矩，开灵成功的学员，这时应该按照排名站在最前面，但是最后一名的关立远却堂而皇之的和钟离秋、魏樱樱站在一起，三个人还小声“屈屈”着什么，不过宋院长只当看不见！
普通刚刚“开灵”成功的小家伙，也不敢在宋院长、甚至还有议员和各家家主面前胡闹，但是钟离秋的身份特殊，而且“圣虎斗士”、“双职业”，足以让他们也装作看不见，尤其是钟离犼，还一副“我女儿这样我超有面子”的样子，其他人还能说什么？

content_en:
[The original poster is really a coward, you can’t just indulge them just because they are your relatives! 】
【Who is my wife? A man! Be more tolerant...]
【...Has been blocked! 】
(Ahem, if you don’t know the allusion of “Eight Consecutive Kills of the God of Cookery”, you are welcome to read Dongdong’s previous novel “The Fake Master of the Cookery Halberd”.)
Even worse than the blacklist is the current expression on the head of the Gonglian family.
Several councilors from Dulan City strangely glanced at the face of the head of the Gonglian family who turned into a scapegoat...
The heads of other families can still control themselves, but the head of the Zhongli family is already humming.
After listening to Guan Liyuan's words, they could probably understand what was going on!
Although with the status of the Gong family in Dulan City, it is impossible for Guan Liyuan to be really hurt by just a word, even if he has both spiritual and spiritual skills!
Of course, if there are dual professions such as "Space Controller" and "Soul Walker", it may really shock the alliance, and it is not impossible to uproot the Gong family.
Even now, Gonglian knew that there would be no real damage, but... it was so embarrassing!
At this time, Gong Lian was already scolding Tian Gonghao to pieces.
The Gong family has more than one housekeeper. To be precise, Tian Gonghao was named a "housekeeper" just because he was a relative of his concubine!
If things were normal, Guan Liyuan would also become Tian Gong's private slave, just borrowing the reputation of the Gong family.
It's just a "little advantage" for the Gong family, but they actually retaliate without asking!
And the other person who was deeply hated by Gong Lianji was naturally Guan Liyuan who rejected his "good intentions"...
How dare a boy with such bad luck dare to confront the Gong family? Who gave him the courage!
At this time, Zhong Lijian added insult to injury and said: "Bah! He really disgraced the people of Duran City... Oh, Head Gonglian, I didn't talk about you, I was thinking about other things just now. Well, how much do you want for one year's tuition for the sixth grade, plus the 'favor fee'? I'll have someone send it to your house later."
Councilor Ba also said at this time: "What's going on? You only went to school for four months?"
If Guan Liyuan's "opening of spirit" had not been successful, the alliance members would never have taken this initiative, but the situation is naturally different now. Even Dean Song looked a little ugly and glared at Director Xin who looked at him for help.
The head of the Gonglian family said slowly: "Well, I will see who is responsible for this when I get back, and I will send him to the alliance in the afternoon!" At this time, he had decided to give up on Tian Gong.
And when Dean Song saw that the head of the Gong family had abandoned his car to protect the commander, he didn't even dare to resist!
"Xin Bo! Stand up for me! You are the director in charge of student records. If you can't explain clearly today, just go to the alliance's trial center yourself!"
"House, Dean...I..." Director Xin already knew his fate. He never thought that a set of fake files he "randomly" made four months ago would actually implicate a genius who had awakened to dual professions!
At the same time, he also understood that this meant that he was finished...
Not only does the director's career end here, I'm afraid it will take who knows how long it will take for him to come out after entering the trial court... I also hope that Guan Liyuan will not have any outstanding performance in the future, otherwise he may not have a chance to come out.
"Dean Song! This is not just a problem for the person who manages the archives! You will also check yourself later. After this year's term is up, there is no need for you to continue to be the dean!" Councilor Ba said.
There are differences between people. The Gong family can give up their car to keep the commander in chief, but Dean Song... obviously cannot keep his position as dean.
At this time, Guan Liyuan noticed that Councilor Ba looked at him apologetically, as if to indicate that he could only do this...
Guan Liyuan also understood the alliance's predicament and reluctantly smiled at the Pakistani congressman.
althoughAlthough he understood, Guan Liyuan still couldn't accept it, otherwise he wouldn't have directly asked Zhong Liqiu to help him pay back the money...
Dean Song had a mournful expression on his face, but thinking that his term was already short and he had finally retired early, he steeled himself and continued to complete his graduation speech.
Of course, the atmosphere among the students is a bit strange now, especially when looking at Guan Liyuan who is already standing in the front row...
Originally, according to the rules, the students who successfully opened their spirits should stand at the front according to their ranking, but Guan Liyuan, who came in last, stood majestically with Zhong Liqiu and Wei Yingying. The three of them even whispered something, but Dean Song just pretended not to see it!
Ordinary little guys who have just successfully "opened up their spirits" would not dare to mess around in front of Dean Song, even the councilors and the heads of various families. However, Zhong Liqiu's special status, "Sacred Tiger Fighter" and "dual profession" are enough for them to pretend not to see it, especially Zhong Lijian, who still looks like "I am very proud of my daughter." What can others say?
